_comment: Sonarr queue rows whose import was refused for an executable payload.
Every title here is INVENTED (INV-15): nothing in this file may be
traceable to a member request, and the repo is public.
Row 1  - the positive case: phrase AND extension in ONE message string.
Row 2  - INV-2 negative control: the release TITLE contains .exe and the
statusMessages are benign. Must classify as completed-not-imported,
Row 3  - INV-3 negative control: the phrase is in one message and a bare
.exe in a DIFFERENT one. Not a match.
Row 4  - extension-boundary control: .json must not match the .js token.
